import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Dataset provided as a string
data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Since the sample dataset is very small (5 rows) and all 'is_fraud' values are 0,
# focusing on the relationship between 'amount', 'hour_of_day', and 'transaction_type'
# will be most informative. A scatter plot allows visualizing individual transactions.

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='hour_of_day',
    y='amount',
    hue='transaction_type',
    style='transaction_type',
    s=200, # Increase point size for better visibility of individual points
    palette='viridis'
)

plt.title('Transaction Amount vs. Hour of Day by Transaction Type', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(range(0, 24, 2)) # Set x-ticks for hourly intervals
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.legend(title='Transaction Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the visualization as output.png
plt.savefig('output.png')
